title: Trucking
description: A trucking shot is a lateral dolly: the camera slides sideways with a walker, a sidewalk or corridor peeling by. Subject size holds; the world streams along the street axis.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Stay beside a walker. Talk, walk, and the city or the hallway becomes a moving set.
The camera is a polite companion, not a hunter in front and not a conveyor belt. If you lead from the front, you are tracking or following.
If the world is a factory that does not care, you are on a conveyor. Trucking is the side-on companion.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Track parallel to the walk, camera at eye or chest, often 35 to 50mm. Match speed to the stride.
Foreground (posts, extras, doorways) should shear; the far wall crawls. Prompt: Trucking with [Subject], lateral dolly, the camera sliding sideways, a sidewalk or corridor peeling by.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to stay beside a walker through a street or hall. Do not truck on a static portrait; then you only have a slider fidget.

blocks.text: Dolly Left names a lateral direction on wheels. Tracking Shot is the broader follow along a path, including front and behind.
Conveyor is constant industrial speed with the person as cargo. A Pan from sticks will lose the walker or smear them.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Goodfellas Copacabana take includes lateral travel through service spaces as a companion. Touch of Evil moves with people through a town so the street peels.
Grammar: beside, matching speed, lateral parallax.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a pan with a walking person. The tell: the subject changes size and the background only swings.
The fix: translate sideways, match stride, keep size, let the sidewalk peel.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Trucking in film?
Trucking is a lateral dolly beside a walker. The camera slides sideways so the sidewalk or corridor peels by and the subject stays a constant size.
Trucking vs Tracking
Tracking is the general follow along a path, including front and behind. Trucking is specifically the side-on, lateral companion.
When should I use Trucking?
Use it to stay beside a person walking and talking. Do not use it on a locked portrait.
How do I prompt Trucking for AI image or video?
Write a lateral dolly matching walk speed. Example: Trucking with [Subject], lateral dolly, the camera sliding sideways, a sidewalk or corridor peeling by.
